checks.keyboardSelectionAndFocus: real-model automated regression; not claimed as native OS-keyboard sampling

limitations: Small sample series from one Mac and deterministic fixture, not a universal FPS guarantee or statistical proof.
First-load wallMs includes fixture creation, canvas/layout/render readiness and 350 ms settling; excludes process startup and database/network operations.
Reload means canvas unmount/remount inside one native process, not Vite code HMR.
Dragging uses six real DOM/React Flow gestures, 90 mousemove steps and full recovery; not OS pointer dispatch.
Current controls use the same selected-target readiness guard; the final harness additionally rejects an empty viewport at readiness. Valid scored samples have the same complete viewport geometry.
Profiling/CPU-sampled runs are diagnostic only. React commit callbacks omit later browser, passive-effect and scheduling costs.
No mid-sample AX/screenshot reads, tests, builds or stack sampling in scored runs; all their raw focus audits are retained.
WebKit Long Tasks API is unavailable: null does not mean no long tasks.
No new memory-performance claim is made.

invalidControlBuild.cause: Temporary source-copy import rewrite also rewrote dot-prefixed CSS selectors; fixed and rebuilt before the valid controls. Production source unchanged.

cpuDiagnostic.observations: Mixed unsymbolized JavaScript, Map/string operations, render-tree and collector activity. Cannot align any exact formal long frame to a single native stack.
